changes: General borrowed projected scans now pass an allocation scope to physical execution, selection gathering and projection.
Detach only selected borrowed output and share owned row materialization; release stage, detached input and materialized output on iterator cleanup.
Enforce backend allocation-scope capabilities for borrowed scans as for owned scans. Optional WebGPU falls back to CPU; required WebGPU rejects unsupported scoped selection.

coverage: Eight borrowed scan cases: streaming/collected, filtered/unfiltered, offset-limit/unlimited; mutable binary backing survives scanner reuse.
Exact observed peak succeeds; one byte below rejects; scanner closes and reservations return to zero on both success and budget failure.
Real fixture and HTTP tests included in the full default suite.
WebGPU auto and required placement policies explicitly tested.

remaining: Borrowed projected toOwnedArray eligibility and deferred-limit ownership are not yet unified.
WebGPU scoped selection allocation support remains incomplete; required acceleration for this query path is a compatibility limitation to resolve before final acceptance.
Projected read-column planning and other planner/runtime metadata still require admission.
No new cloud-specific benchmark or whole-runtime 64/128 MiB cap proof is supplied by this change.
